title: Check yourself: Examples, reasoning, long documents and chains

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A prompt for Claude Sonnet 5.5 ends the `messages` list with an assistant turn that opens a JSON brace, to force the format. What happens?

options.text: The reply continues the brace, as it would on Claude Sonnet 4.5 or older models
options.says: Ruled out because only "Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, and older models accept one".

options.text: The call is rejected with a 400 error, since the model does not accept that pattern
options.says: The page says that Claude Sonnet 5.5 "rejects a prefilled last assistant turn with a 400 error".

options.text: The brace is dropped and the call succeeds with the normal reply
options.says: Ruled out because the page says that "Requests with prefilled assistant messages to these models return a 400 error", so no call succeeds.

options.text: The reply is cut off at the first closing brace that the model writes
options.says: Ruled out because a request that "rejects a prefilled last assistant turn" never reaches generation, so no reply is cut off.

questions.stem: An analyst sends Claude a 60,000 token agreement plus one request about it. Which layout follows the page?

options.text: The instruction at the very start, then each tagged section after it
options.says: Ruled out because "Queries at the end can improve response quality by up to 30 percent in tests".

options.text: The instruction and the long text woven together paragraph by paragraph
options.says: Ruled out because the rule is to "Place your long documents and inputs near the top of your prompt", not to interleave them.

options.text: The instruction in the system prompt and the long text placed last
options.says: Ruled out because the rule puts the long inputs "near the top of your prompt", not last.

options.text: Tagged long text at the top, with the instruction at the very end
options.says: The page says to "Place your long documents and inputs near the top of your prompt, above your query, instructions, and examples", and to wrap each in tags.

origin.section: Long documents: top, tags, quotes, question last

questions.stem: A team wants Claude Opus 5.5 to reason less on simple tickets. What does the page advise?

options.text: Add "do not think" to the system prompt and trust the model to comply
options.says: Ruled out because "Asking it in the system prompt to think less doesn't reliably reduce its thinking."

options.text: Reduce the effort setting first, and only then rewrite the prompt
options.says: The page says "To get less thinking, lower the effort level first".

options.text: Turn thinking off altogether with a parameter on the request
options.says: Ruled out because "thinking is always on and adaptive thinking is the only mode" on Claude Opus 5.5.

options.text: Ask for reasoning in an output field, then cut it
options.says: Ruled out because "A property that asks for the model's thinking or step-by-step reasoning may lead to a `reasoning_extraction` refusal."
